entities.summary: Alison Margaret Smithson and Peter Denham Smithson were English architects who together formed an architectural partnership. They are associated with New Brutalism in architectural and urban theory. Alison Smithson was a architects & engineers from Sheffield (1928-06-22, Sheffield–1993-08-16). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
